sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:57

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:57:1
items.html: Hochma always cancels the others, and then all three are annulled in the Ot Yod י. It means that Komat Hochma contains within it all the other lower Komot, as the Rav says above (item 37): “We have a great rule in our hands: the Elyon is greater than everything below it.” Thus, each Koma is named only after its highest Sefira.
